findings.message: Both bhāvārthas add a claim that no pada makes. EN says 'the last syllable of the prayer namaḥ śivāya', and HI says the same with 'जो 'नमः शिवाय' मन्त्र का अन्तिम अक्षर है'. The verse only says ya-kāra, 'the letter ya' (mw-yakara). Linking it to the five-syllable mantra is background. It is well supported (annotation a2, text-report.md 'Akṣara'), but docs/EDITORIAL_GUIDE.md ('True to the text') puts background in the story card, not the bhāvārtha. 'open directions' / 'खुली दिशाएँ' is a smaller addition of the same kind. A human should decide whether the summary may keep this.
findings.suggested_fix: EN: 'The poet bows to Him as the sound ya.' HI: 'कवि उन्हें 'य' अक्षर के रूप में प्रणाम करता है।' Leave the mantra link to card a2.
